scope: Read-only comparison of 15 reserved Gears of War/Dead Space heroes; no assets, identity IDs, source records, CG plans or runtime code modified.
historicalGraphVerification: All present listed modules are byte-identical to the immutable 98991b161 Git source; historical getExtinctionFighterProfile is imported from that graph. Current runtime protocol module is byte-identical to historical and is shared for both exercise states.

notes: Nine real previous bullet primaries need exact source-bound ammo/reload/hitscan compatibility, not a universal projectile fallback.
Baird and Kait require separately tested intentional physical-rifle FPS adapters: their old generic energy/melee actions are not the canon baseline to restore.
Isaac uses the 211-V Plasma Cutter and must remain outside ballistic rifle bindings. This review does not automatically approve visual fidelity or the timing of its energy projectile.
Nicole and Kendra have source-backed unarmed support profiles already effective in RPG/melee; their old pseudoattacks and ammo are not canon firearm behavior to restore.
The retained hammond_ds actor ID keeps its historical raw bullet primary and unresolved action review; do not merge it with zach_hammond.

All four actions are exercised independently with a fresh owned state, full special charge, a target one unit forward, and ninety ticks; immediate ammo, mitigation, damage and projectile counts are retained.
findings.defenseTuningInterpretation: All 15 defenses activate and mitigate damage. Changes in duration/reduction/cooldown are exact existing canonical source-profile projections; they are observable FPS balance changes, not unchanged historical FPS tuning. This report records them and does not label whole FPS profiles identical.
findings.guardDamageMetadataExplanation: The guard branch mitigates incoming damage and does not use this damage field to attack. The generic old numeric damage28 metadata becoming0 is separate from actual reduction/duration tuning.

workingTreeConsumerFreeze: Freeze3 source sha256 4ffe9ec65bd4ceb0997fe954d58542c5a19b50532c16cdb9e09f593570dae6fc; currentCommit identifies HEAD while sourcePins identify the exact reviewed working-tree files.

method.historicalProfileFunction: getExtinctionFighterProfile from private historical module graph; exact module bytes checked against git show 98991b161
method.actorBefore: Full raw actor from baseline-runtime.json.gz, originally captured from immutable source98991b161
method.actorCurrent: HEROES_DB actual runtime lookup by exact id and universe; deep equality against frozen runtime-after.json.gz actor verified
method.runtimeExecution: createExtinctionProtocolState + activateExtinctionProtocol + 90 ticks from unchanged extinctionSignatures.js; SHA equals historical source
method.state: Fresh owned run per actor/slot/side, hp20/120 ammo24 reserve72, one target hp500 one unit forward, charge100
method.noChanges: Only two new review artifacts were written inside the repository: fps-impact-review.json and its gzip details. No product/source/CG/asset edits.

limitations: Independent source/runtime adapter audit, not browser visual verification or art/1:1 certification.
Portal/Left4Dead16 heroes remain owned and tested by menus_logistics; this independent cohort covers exactly Gears/DeadSpace15.
The historical generic FPS raw action balance is compared explicitly; canonical RPG/melee profile equality remains separately proved by the lot delta and independent native review.

details.content: Full raw actions, complete before/current profiles, and immediate/90-tick observations for all120 independently executed actions.
